fire: The Great Exhibition of 1851 was opened in Hyde Park by Queen Victoria herself.
Balmoral Castle in Scotland was bought for Queen Victoria by Prince Albert.
At the height of the British Empire, under Queen Victoria, India was ruled from London.
Prince Albert, the husband of Queen Victoria, died of typhoid in 1861.
The Diamond Jubilee of 1897 celebrated sixty years on the throne for Queen Victoria.
Tennyson was made Poet Laureate and became a favourite of Queen Victoria.
Osborne House on the Isle of Wight was the seaside home of Queen Victoria.
The 1840 wedding of Queen Victoria and Albert made white dresses fashionable.
quiet: The Spanish Armada of 1588 was defeated during the reign of Queen Elizabeth herself.
Versailles in France was enlarged for King Louis by his architects.
At the height of the Russian Empire, under Empress Catherine, Crimea was ruled from Moscow.
Prince Philip, the husband of Queen Elizabeth, died at Windsor in 2021.
The Golden Jubilee of 2002 celebrated fifty years on the throne for Queen Elizabeth.
Shakespeare wrote plays and became a favourite of King James.
Schönbrunn Palace in Vienna was the summer home of Empress Maria Theresa.
The 1981 wedding of Prince Charles and Diana made puffed sleeves fashionable.
